objective: Al terminar escribes un correo formal claro y profesional: asunto, saludo, petición, detalles y cierre con el registro adecuado.

warmup.prompt_es: Un correo formal se juzga en segundos. Si el tono, la estructura y el vocabulario son correctos, la gente te responde antes y mejor.

text: Subject: Request for information about the Project Coordinator position
I am writing to enquire about the Project Coordinator position advertised on your website on 3 March. I am very interested in the role, as it matches both my training and my professional experience.

I have been working as an assistant project manager at Brightline Ltd for the past four years. During this time, I have coordinated teams of up to twelve people and delivered three major projects on schedule. I would be grateful if you could confirm whether the position is still open and let me know the closing date for applications.
In addition, I would appreciate it if you could tell me whether the post is based in the London office or whether remote work is possible. I have attached my CV for your consideration.
I look forward to hearing from you.
input.es: Asunto: Solicitud de información sobre el puesto de coordinador/a de proyectos. Estimada Sra. Hartley: Le escribo para informarme sobre el puesto de coordinador de proyectos anunciado en su web el 3 de marzo. Me interesa mucho el puesto, ya que coincide con mi formación y mi experiencia profesional. Trabajo como asistente de dirección de proyectos en Brightline Ltd desde hace cuatro años. Durante este tiempo he coordinado equipos de hasta doce personas y he entregado tres proyectos importantes en plazo. Le agradecería que confirmara si el puesto sigue abierto y me indicara la fecha límite para presentar candidaturas. Además, le agradecería que me dijera si el puesto está en la oficina de Londres o si es posible el trabajo remoto. Adjunto mi currículum para su consideración. Quedo a la espera de sus noticias. Atentamente, Elena Ruiz.

glossary.example: I look forward to hearing from you.

md_es: **Estructura de un correo formal**
| Parte | Frases útiles |
| **Asunto** | *Request for information about … · Application for … · Complaint regarding …* |
| **Saludo** | *Dear Mr / Ms / Dr Smith,* (conocido) · *Dear Sir or Madam,* (desconocido) |
| **Motivo** | *I am writing to enquire about … / to apply for … / to complain about …* |
| **Detalles** | *I have been working as … for … · During this time, I have …* |
| **Petición** | *I would be grateful if you could … · I would appreciate it if you could … · Could you possibly …?* |
| **Adjuntos** | *Please find attached … · I have attached …* |
| **Cierre** | *I look forward to hearing from you. · Thank you for your time and consideration.* |
| **Despedida** | *Yours sincerely,* (con nombre) · *Yours faithfully,* (Dear Sir or Madam) · *Kind regards / Best regards* (menos formal) |
**Registro formal**
- Sin contracciones: *I am writing*, no *I'm writing*; *I would be grateful*, no *I'd be thankful*.
- Verbos formales: *enquire* (preguntar), *request* (pedir), *require* (necesitar), *attend* (asistir), *regarding* (en cuanto a).
- Evita *Hi, Hey, Thanks a lot, Cheers* y signos de exclamación.
**Peticiones cortés: 'would be grateful / would appreciate it'**
- *I would be grateful if you could confirm …* (pasado tras if).
- *I would appreciate it if you could …* (nunca *appreciate if you could* sin *it*).
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *I would appreciate if you could…* → ✔ *I would appreciate it if you could …*
- ✘ *I'm writing for ask…* → ✔ *I am writing to ask …*
- ✘ *Yours faithfully, Ms Hartley* (nombre conocido) → ✔ *Yours sincerely.*
- ✘ *Dear Ms Hartley, Hi,* → no mezclar registros.
**Ojo:** *regards* (saludos) ≠ *regarding* (con respecto a). *Enquire* (BrE) = *inquire* (AmE). *Informations* no existe: *information* es incontable.
Pronunciación: *enquire* /ɪnˈkwaɪə/ · *grateful* /ˈɡreɪtfl/ · *consideration* /kənˌsɪdəˈreɪʃn/.

self_check_es: ¿Haces dos peticiones con would be grateful / would appreciate it?
model_answer: Subject: Request for information about the Business English course

I am writing to enquire about the Business English course advertised on your website. I am currently working as an administrative assistant, and I would like to improve my spoken English for meetings. I would be grateful if you could tell me the dates of the next course and the price. I would also appreciate it if you could let me know whether classes are held in the evening. I have attached a short description of my level for your consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.
